findings: ARCHIVED status badge uses yellow/outline instead of muted gray. Change to variant='secondary' with muted text color to match DRAFT treatment, or explain why yellow is intentional.

Category filter built from paginated results only. The categories array derives from the current page's blogs, so switching status filters can hide categories that exist in the full dataset. Move category list calculation to the server action.
No confirmation on publish/unpublish actions. These status transitions apply immediately without confirmation, which may surprise users expecting a safety check before affecting public visibility.
Type assertion 'status as any' in page.tsx bypasses type checking. Use a type guard or explicit cast to BlogStatus | undefined.
EmptyState component accepts optional action prop but BlogTable doesn't provide one. Consider adding a 'Create Blog' action or remove the unused prop.
Skeleton count mismatch: BlogTable loading state renders 5 skeleton rows but pagination shows 10 results per page. Change to Array.from({ length: 10 }) or make configurable.
